target_customer: Sales and Sales Ops teams that run on Salesforce
problem: Revenue tooling is fragmented across point solutions for forecasting, pipeline management and lead routing that do not share data, and Salesforce admin work is slow.
business_model: B2B SaaS sold to Salesforce-based sales teams, SSO setup with no implementation
product_category: Sales and sales ops platform layered on Salesforce

founders.name: Daniel Ruiz
founders.background_notes: Source: YC company page. Education not listed.

founders.name: Asad Dar
founders.background_notes: Named on the YC company page; the launch post is signed by Asad and Daniel. No background given.

exit.reason: YC lists the company as inactive; no shutdown notice or acquisition found

competitors.name: Scratchpad
competitors.what: Productivity workspace layered on Salesforce for sales teams
competitors.funding_then: $13M Series A (Feb 2021), about $16.6M total at that point; a $33M Series B followed in Jan 2022 per a second search result

technical_complexity.rationale: Salesforce SSO integration, forecasting and routing features plus LLM generation of Apex code and flows from plain text; standard SaaS engineering with some hard integration work for a team of four.

defensibility.rationale: Built entirely on top of Salesforce data, so Salesforce itself or any workspace vendor could copy features; value depends on being embedded in daily sales workflows.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Salesforce shipped its own generative AI assistants in 2023; no source found on how that affected Synch.

market_need_then: The launch post argues sales stacks are split across many point tools; Salesforce admin work is a known cost for sales ops teams. No quantified demand evidence in the sources reviewed.

branding.domain_note: Company site is withsynch.com (a prefix domain); no acquisition history found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain, benefit led launch post with the tagline Just SSO and go

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence about the brand found; the name is a respelling of sync and similar names exist (Synchronoss, SyncSketch).

outcome_analysis: Synch raised a small YC convertible note and, per a startup news aggregator, a $3M seed in March 2024 with AltCap and Haystack, then went quiet; the YC directory lists it as inactive but no shutdown post or acquisition was found, so the cause is not public. The wedge sat directly on Salesforce, which was shipping its own AI assistants in 2023, and the 2024 funding was not followed by any found later round.
